transcript.text: Thank you, Maya. Let me provide the full parameters of the ER developmental reset guidance for the record. The guidance for a first substantiated communication pattern of this kind calls for a 30-day developmental reset period, during which a facilitated repair meeting should be held before any formal performance-improvement plan is initiated. The 30-day reset is intended as a developmental — not disciplinary — measure, giving the individual an opportunity to adjust their communication approach with structured support. The facilitated repair meeting is meant to bring together the affected parties to address the specific communication patterns, establish clearer norms for raising and responding to corrections, and rebuild working trust. Only if the pattern persists after the 30-day reset and facilitated repair meeting would escalation to a formal performance-improvement plan be recommended under current ER guidance. I'd note that Beatriz's capability evidence — Alex's completion of the conflict-coaching course and successful mediation experience — is relevant here, as it suggests Alex may be well-positioned to engage constructively with the developmental reset.
